reason: Committing a reviewed MVP card group onto a shared, dirty main needed pathspec-only commits, a verified cached stat, and a hunk-level split for a file two cards share. No existing skill covers committing from the main checkout by pathspec; land-worktree-commits-on-main covers a different case (worktree commits onto main through a temp index).

Leftover tree state with no card hand-back (ignore rules, a dependency Ivan ruled to keep, curator skill ledgers) was committed in this episode. Commit messages claimed less verification than was run, and had to be amended. The rule for these groups should be explicit.

A skills-only commit ran `git add -A -- .claude/skills`, which staged every change in that directory, including peer-session edits, and the stat was never checked against an explicit list. Step 10 must forbid directory-wide adds.
